entries.status: No EU-level schedule or class. EU legislation does not establish classes of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Member States classify drugs according to the 1961, 1971 and 1988 UN Conventions. The Framework Decision on illicit drug trafficking defines 'drug' as any substance covered by the 1961 Single Convention (as amended by the 1972 Protocol) or by the 1971 Convention, or listed in its Annex.

entries.note: Entries in the Perechen are unnumbered; no item number is printed. List I = substances whose circulation in Russia is prohibited («оборот которых в Российской Федерации запрещен»). Methadone is in List I (prohibited circulation), not List II. «Метадона промежуточный продукт (4-циано-2-диметиламино-4,4-дифенилбутан)» (methadone intermediate) is a separate List I position. The general provisions after List I extend control to its isomers and stereoisomers («если таковые определенно не исключены»), esters and ethers, salts, and all mixtures regardless of quantity.

entries.note: Art. 40 opens «هركس عالمًا عامداً به قصد تبديل يا توليد مواد مخدر» (anyone who knowingly and deliberately, to convert or produce narcotics) and first covers precursors in Tables I and II of the 1988 Convention; whether that intent applies to the codeine and methadone clause is a penal question, not settled here. Art. 41's general exemption for medical, research and industrial uses with a Ministry of Health permit applies to 'prohibited substances'; medical_use is null.
